summary: Enable secure pre-registered Google OAuth for the curated Gmail connector.
features: Configure a Google Web OAuth client through secret Home Assistant add-on options.
Connect the curated Gmail MCP server using Google authorization-code OAuth with PKCE.
Copy the exact Home Assistant Ingress OAuth callback URL directly from the Gmail catalog card.
Retain offline refresh access so Gmail remains connected across add-on restarts.
Prioritize Home Assistant entity tools for clear device power commands before repository, plugin, memory, or web tools.
fixes: Support OAuth providers that require a pre-registered client without weakening dynamic-registration providers.
Request provider-advertised scopes and Google offline consent parameters.
Keep Google credentials out of repository files and expose only configuration readiness in diagnostics.
Keep Gmail write-capable tools approval-gated after discovery.
Prevent common device power commands from entering repository-tool discovery or web search.
Retain the Home Assistant control fast path when Developer Mode was left enabled, without exposing Workshop Memory tools.
Coalesce Home Assistant entity lookup and control rounds into one activity indicator and elapsed timer.
Use the visible Shared Files inventory instead of directory metadata for activity detection.
Clear tab activity reliably when its content is viewed and remove the Shared Files system label.
Preserve per-chat voice playback, low-latency speech, semantic activity indicators, and New Chat reset.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
